data.title: SDR Drone Enters Agreement for Proposed Financing Placement
data.description:
An announcement from SDR Drone ( (SDCO) ) is now available.

On November 10, 2026, SDR Drone, Inc., a Florida corporation, entered an engagement with Dawson James Securities to serve as lead placement agent, on a best-efforts, non-exclusive basis, for a proposed bridge financing and/or private placement of convertible debt, equity or equity-linked securities. The engagement targeted gross proceeds of $2.5 million to $3 million, while Dawson James had no obligation to buy securities or ensure a successful placement.

Terms included a non-refundable $50,000 retainer credited against a 7% fee on proceeds from investors introduced by Dawson James, plus five-year warrants equal to 3% of securities issued to those investors, exercisable at 110% of the offering price. Because the company was subject to a Rule 506(d) disqualifying order, the offering was to rely on Section 4(a)(2), with restrictions including no general solicitation and sales only to accredited investors; no retainer note had been issued or purchaser identified at the time.

data.description:

data.title: PVAC Proxy Seeks Vote on Proposed Tigerless Health Combination
data.description:
New activity is brewing for Capitalworks Emerging Markets Acquisition Corp Class A ( (CMCAF) ). The company has submitted a Form DEFM14A to the SEC, indicating an upcoming shareholder vote. This form gives shareholders all the information they need to develop an informed vote. Read on to learn more about the proposed company action.

Piermont Valley Acquisition Corp. filed a definitive proxy for a Dec. 9, 2026, virtual extraordinary meeting to vote on its proposed combination with Tigerless Health, Inc. The agreement provides for Tigerless Health to become a wholly owned Pubco subsidiary and for PVAC to become another, through two mergers.

At closing, PVAC ordinary shares would convert into Pubco Class A shares, while outstanding PVAC warrants would become Pubco warrants on substantially similar terms. Pubco has applied to list its Class A common stock and warrants on Nasdaq, and its proposed structure includes generally nonvoting Class A and one-vote-per-share Class B stock.

data.title: CSN Reports R$1,247.3 Million Net Loss in 3Q26
data.description:
An update from Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional ( (SID) ) is now available.

Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional operates steel, mining, cement and energy businesses, including iron ore mining and steel operations. On November 12, 2026, it reported third-quarter net revenue of R$10,485.8 million, down 7.3% from 2Q26 and 11.1% from 3Q25. Adjusted EBITDA fell 32.3% sequentially and 43.5% year over year to R$1,875.9 million, while its margin declined 6.4 and 9.8 percentage points, respectively.

CSN said lower iron ore prices and higher seaborne freight costs weighed on mining, while seasonal weakness affected European steel operations. Steel benefited from operational and pricing improvements, and cement delivered record performance, but the mining segment remained the main source of pressure on profitability.

The company reported a net loss of R$1,247.3 million, compared with net income in 3Q25, as weaker operating performance and other operating expenses affected results. Free cash flow was negative by R$3.5 billion in 3Q26, reversing the positive result of the previous quarter because of weaker operating results and significant debt amortization.

data.description:

data.title: SBC Medical Reports Strong Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
data.description:
An announcement from SBC Medical Group Holdings ( (SBC) ) is now available.

SBC Medical Group Holdings is a Medical Services Organization providing management support to medical institutions across healthcare fields including aesthetic healthcare, dermatology, orthopedics, fertility treatment, gynecology, dentistry, alopecia treatment and ophthalmology. It manages a diverse clinic-brand portfolio and is expanding internationally, particularly in the United States and Asia, through direct operations and medical tourism initiatives.

For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, SBC Medical reported total revenue of $59 million, up 35% year over year, income from operations of $26 million, up 66%, net income attributable to SBC Medical of $16 million, up 22%, and adjusted EBITDA of $28 million, up 66%. Net income margin was 27%, while adjusted EBITDA margin expanded nine percentage points year over year to 47%.

Revenue growth was driven by higher management services revenue, including the service fee structure revisions announced in August, and consolidation of Waqoo. The clinic network reached 293 locations as of September 30, 2026, up 36 locations year over year, while trailing-twelve-month patient visits totaled 7.06 million, up 9%, and average spend per visit rose 4% to $290.

Net cash provided by operating activities totaled $50 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and cash and cash equivalents were $198 million as of September 30. On November 13, 2026, the company posted a 3Q 2026 investor presentation covering its business and results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
